summary: ScienceAgentBench verified split (102 tasks) downloaded and audited. Upstream repo cloned at c26e151. Three domains selected (Bioinformatics #85, Computational Chemistry #16, GIS #21) with one A/B paired run each. All six runs generated real DeepSeek programs with full traces, prompt hashes, strategy hashes and cost records. Official evaluation is BLOCKED for all six runs: benchmark_verified.zip (1.77 GB SharePoint download) is still in progress at ~26% and the required datasets/eval_programs/gold_programs are not yet extracted. Fail-closed behavior verified by 24 passing unit tests. No scores are fabricated. Infrastructure is ready to run official evaluation once artifacts arrive.

tests.notes: 24/24 passed. Covers: verified split loading (102 tasks, 4 domains), task isolation, no answer-key fields, prompt/strategy hash determinism and provenance, placebo arm, budget handling, missing-evaluator fail-closed (raises EvaluatorUnavailable), synthetic-score-never-official, trace JSONL append and overwrite-protection, run-folder isolation, explicit BLOCKED/ERROR statuses, official score parsing, secret redaction, code extraction, environment fingerprint stability.

limitations: One paired seed per domain (seed 0). Not statistically powered; no significance claims.
Agent is direct prompting without self-debug loop, to keep Round 001 resource-bounded.
Strategy B (baseline_first_validation_v1) is a single preregistered generic tactic; fixed before any target-task outcome was observed.
Task 85 pair used --skip-evaluation during smoke testing; its BLOCKED error message differs slightly from tasks 16/21 but both correctly claim zero official evaluations.
benchmark_verified.zip SHA256 and per-dataset checksums will be recorded after the download completes.
DeepSeek model identity is recorded in traces; this is not one of the original SAB-supported engines (OpenAI/Bedrock). Model pinning is documented in experiments/round_001_config.json.
